dossier.public_summary: A 13-day flat-bottom 2.2 Earth-radius signal looks planet-like in shape but appears only in early TESS sectors (1614 and 1580 ppm) and vanishes in later ones (-8 ppm), with almost all signal coming from two outliers. A second dip near phase 0.38 and a large RUWE+astrometric excess with a density-inconsistent transit fit point to systematics or a blend rather than a stable planet.
